_comment: COMPRESSION CLASSES. A glyph shared by several terms is not a collision - it is a claim that those terms name the same underlying structure. Each class carries a grade and a kill condition like any bridge. Ungraded classes do not propagate.
_ladder: Every Law is the same binary expressed in one domain's vocabulary.
chi measures the ratio between the two members of the binary.
The ladder STOPS at the constraint ceiling. Above it is selection, not compression - see layers.json. Compressing further conflates behavior with instantiation.
Two failure directions, one generative band: rigid degradation AND chaotic dissolution both classify as decoherent. Three regimes collapse to two valences.

theBinary._layerNote: CONSTRAINT LAYER, not generative. Describes how systems behave once they exist; does NOT select which world exists. Selection lives at tpl:logos. See layers.json.

coherence.definition: order received from the Source; source-coupled
coherence.laws: the constructive regime of every Law 1-8; Law 10 itself

decoherence.definition: order attempted from the self; self-referential
decoherence.laws: the destructive regime of every Law 1-8; derivative of Law 10

theBinary.note: Law 9 is asymmetric - it does not present two regimes but a direction. Law 10 is asymmetric - coherence is sovereign, decoherence derivative. Laws 1-8 carry the binary symmetrically, regime selected by free will W.
theBinary.killCondition: Exhibit a Law whose two regimes cannot be expressed as source-coupled vs self-referential without redefining either term.

noether.basis: Noether's theorem: a continuous symmetry and a conserved current are the same fact stated twice. An invariant is what the conservation preserves.
noether.killCondition: Exhibit a continuous symmetry with no corresponding conserved quantity in the same system.

shannon.basis: All three are terms of C = A log2(1 + T/D). Signal-to-noise is the ratio inside; capacity is the value; information is what traverses.
shannon.killCondition: Show a channel where capacity is independent of the signal-to-noise ratio.

observer.basis: Resolved in framework: observation and testimony are one act - a state is registered by something outside it. Termination of the observation regress is the Trinity argument.
observer.killCondition: Exhibit observation that registers no testimony, or testimony that registers no observation.

moral-ledger.basis: Justice IS the conserved ledger. Law 9: cost cannot disappear, only transfer. Justice is that conservation named morally.
moral-ledger.killCondition: Exhibit a moral event where the ledger closes with no remainder and no transfer.

curvature.basis: Law 1, Gravitation. Sin IS inward curvature - a mass bending the field toward itself is the same structure as a will bending order toward itself. The glyph carried this definition before the class was declared.
curvature.killCondition: Exhibit sin with no self-directed curvature of relation, or curvature in the moral domain that is not self-directed.

radiance.basis: PROPOSED, NOT RESOLVED. Candidate claim: glory is coherence made visible, and field is coherence extended in space. Plausible but underived.
radiance.killCondition: Show glory attributable to a decohering system, or coherence with no field extension.
radiance.todo: Grade this. It sits on the binary's own pole glyph, so it must not stay ungraded.

aliases._comment: Deprecated or superseded terms resolve here so old atoms stay readable.
